en-US.desktop.remote.title: Remote Development
en-US.desktop.remote.storageHelp: Kept on this computer in {path}. Passwords and the contents of private keys are never saved.
en-US.desktop.remote.empty: No saved connections yet. Fill in the form and save it.
en-US.desktop.remote.name: Name
en-US.desktop.remote.hostPlaceholder: build.example.com or an SSH config alias
en-US.desktop.remote.hostHelp: A host name, an IP address, or a Host alias from ~/.ssh/config. OpenSSH applies its configuration as usual: a field left empty here does not override it.
en-US.desktop.remote.userPlaceholder: Auto (SSH config, otherwise your local user name)
en-US.desktop.remote.authenticationHelp: Auto: as your SSH config and ssh-agent decide. SSH agent: only keys held by ssh-agent. Private key: only the key file you choose; its passphrase is asked when connecting. Password: asked when connecting. Lithe never saves an answer.
en-US.desktop.remote.identityFileHelp: Only the path is saved and handed to OpenSSH; Lithe never reads the key.
en-US.desktop.remote.proxyJumpHelp: Hosts to connect through first, as OpenSSH ProxyJump: [user@]host[:port], several separated by commas.
en-US.desktop.remote.keepAliveHelp: How often OpenSSH checks that the server still answers (ServerAliveInterval), so a dropped network is noticed.
en-US.desktop.remote.testing: Connecting… OpenSSH may ask for a password or to confirm the host key.
en-US.desktop.remote.probe.unsupported: Connected to {system} {machine}, but Lithe’s remote server does not run there yet: only x86_64 and arm64 Linux are supported.
en-US.desktop.remote.probe.authenticationFaile: Authentication failed: the server did not accept the keys or password offered.
en-US.desktop.remote.probe.hostKeyRejected: The host key was not accepted: it was declined, or it differs from the one in known_hosts.
en-US.desktop.remote.probe.unreachable: Cannot reach the host: check the host, the port and the network.
en-US.desktop.remote.probe.noSSH: No ssh client found. Install the OpenSSH client first.
en-US.desktop.remote.error.duplicate: Another saved connection already uses this.
en-US.desktop.remote.error.nameDuplicate: Another saved connection already has this name.
en-US.desktop.remote.error.full: At most 128 connections can be saved. Delete one first.
en-US.desktop.remote.error.hostInvalid: Enter only a host name, an IP address or an SSH alias; put the user and the port in their own fields.
en-US.desktop.remote.error.userInvalid: This user name has characters SSH does not accept.
en-US.desktop.remote.error.textInvalid: Remove the spaces at either end and any control characters.
en-US.desktop.remote.damaged: The saved connections in {path} cannot be read. Repair or remove the file before saving.
en-US.desktop.remote.conflict: The saved connections changed elsewhere and were read again. Save once more.
en-US.desktop.remote.unavailable: There is no preference folder to keep connections in.
en-US.desktop.remoteAuth.title: SSH Authentication
en-US.desktop.remoteAuth.secretHint: The answer goes only to this SSH connection. Lithe does not keep it.
en-US.desktop.remoteAuth.refused: SSH did not take the answer: it may be at most 8192 bytes and may not contain a line break. The question was cancelled.
en-US.desktop.remoteAuth.failed: Cannot pass the answer to SSH: {reason}
en-US.desktop.remote.untested: Test the connection to see the host's system, CPUs, memory and disk.
en-US.desktop.remote.colorHelp: Marks the connection in the list, for example to tell production from test hosts. Kept on this computer only.
en-US.desktop.remote.groupHelp: The list shows connections under their group. Group names that differ only in case are the same group.
en-US.desktop.remote.error.groupInvalid: A group name cannot contain line breaks, tabs or other control characters.

zh-CN.desktop.remote.title: 远程开发
zh-CN.desktop.remote.storageHelp: 保存在本机的 {path}。不会保存密码和私钥内容。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.empty: 还没有保存的连接。填写右侧表单后保存。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.name: 名称
zh-CN.desktop.remote.hostPlaceholder: build.example.com 或 SSH 配置里的别名
zh-CN.desktop.remote.hostHelp: 主机名、IP 地址或 ~/.ssh/config 里的 Host 别名。OpenSSH 照常读取它的配置；这里留空的字段不会覆盖配置里的值。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.userPlaceholder: 自动（SSH 配置，否则本机用户名）
zh-CN.desktop.remote.authenticationHelp: 自动：按 SSH 配置和 ssh-agent 决定。SSH Agent：只用 ssh-agent 里的密钥。私钥文件：只用选定的私钥，口令在连接时询问。密码：在连接时询问。Lithe 不保存任何回答。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.identityFileHelp: 只保存路径并交给 OpenSSH；Lithe 不读取私钥内容。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.proxyJumpHelp: 先经过这些主机再连接，等同 OpenSSH 的 ProxyJump：[用户@]主机[:端口]，多个用逗号分隔。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.keepAliveHelp: OpenSSH 每隔多久确认一次服务器仍有响应（ServerAliveInterval），以便发现网络已断开。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.testing: 正在连接…OpenSSH 可能会询问密码或请你确认主机密钥。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.probe.unsupported: 已连接到 {system} {machine}，但 Lithe 远程服务目前不支持该平台：只支持 x86_64 和 arm64 的 Linux。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.probe.authenticationFaile: 身份验证失败：服务器没有接受提供的密钥或密码。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.probe.hostKeyRejected: 主机密钥没有通过验证：你拒绝了它，或者它与 known_hosts 里记录的不一致。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.probe.unreachable: 无法连接到主机：请检查主机、端口和网络。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.probe.noSSH: 找不到 ssh 客户端，请先安装 OpenSSH 客户端。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.error.duplicate: 另一个已保存的连接已在使用这个值。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.error.nameDuplicate: 已有同名的连接（不区分大小写）。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.error.full: 最多保存 128 个连接，请先删除一个。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.error.hostInvalid: 只填主机名、IP 地址或 SSH 别名；用户名和端口请填到各自的字段。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.error.portInvalid: 请填 1 到 65535 之间的端口。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.error.userInvalid: 用户名含有 SSH 不接受的字符。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.error.proxyJumpInvalid: 格式为 [用户@]主机[:端口]，多个用逗号分隔。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.error.textInvalid: 请去掉首尾空格和控制字符。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.damaged: 无法读取 {path} 里保存的连接。修复或删除这个文件之前不能保存。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.conflict: 已保存的连接在别处被修改过，已重新读取，请再保存一次。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.readFailed: 无法读取已保存的连接：{reason}
zh-CN.desktop.remote.unavailable: 没有可以保存连接的偏好设置目录。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteAuth.title: SSH 身份验证
zh-CN.desktop.remoteAuth.secretHint: 回答只交给这次 SSH 连接，Lithe 不会保存。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteAuth.refused: SSH 没有接受这个回答：回答最多 8192 字节，且不能包含换行。这个问题已取消。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.untested: 测试连接后，这里会显示主机的系统、CPU、内存和磁盘。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.colorHelp: 在列表中标记这个连接，例如区分生产和测试主机。只保存在本机。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.groupHelp: 左侧列表按分组列出连接。只差大小写的分组名视为同一个分组。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.error.groupInvalid: 分组名不能包含换行、制表符等控制字符。
